summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Freezy Prop Firm Command Center. 17/17 backend pytest tests passed covering settings auto-seed, dashboard aggregation, plan 90-day auto-seed & update, account CRUD with auto-priced 25K/50K, status transition auto-stamps, funded-days $150 threshold + idempotency, payout split & numbering, journal CRUD with base64 screenshot, copy trading master exclusivity, and achievement unlocks. Frontend Expo web preview loads cleanly on mobile viewport (390x844); all 4 bottom tabs (Command/Accounts/Planner/Journal) render correctly; Accounts create-modal flow works (filled name -> 50K -> Create -> account appears in list); account detail screen exposes status pills, profit/consistency inputs, funded-day form & payouts section; Planner 90-day grid renders and tap-to-open bottom sheet with R input, 6 checklist toggles, notes & Save; Journal '+' opens full Log Trade modal with all fields and Analytics tab renders R-growth and R-distribution; all 5 Home quick actions (Payouts/Copy Trading/Achievements/Settings/Goal-via-trophy) navigate to correct screens with correct content. No red screen, no React Native errors, no deprecated expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch). Two console warnings observed (non-blocking): props.pointerEvents deprecated and shadow* style props deprecated.

issues: Day cells label '2.33R' wraps onto two lines on some cells (e.g., '2.33R' shown with the R below); consider increasing cell width or reducing font size for the targetR label
'CONSISTENCY' label wraps to two lines ('CONSISTENC / Y') in the 4-column metric grid - shorten label to 'CONSIST.' or expand cell width

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - likely from a library or inline prop. Non-blocking but should be migrated.

Web console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' - likely in StyleSheet entries using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Migrate to boxShadow on web (or keep platform-specific) to silence warning.

action_items: Optional: Replace props.pointerEvents (React Native View prop) with style.pointerEvents to clear web warning.
Optional: Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow for web compatibility (Platform.select recommended).
Optional UI polish: Shorten 'CONSISTENCY' label on Accounts card (e.g., 'CONSIST. %') so it does not wrap; tune Planner day-cell width so '2.33R' fits on one line.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~580 lines and within acceptable single-file size for a single-user app; could be split into routers per resource if it grows.

ensure_plan deletes & re-inserts all plan_days whenever total count is below tradingDaysAvailable AND when plan-affecting settings change - this destroys existing rEarned/notes/checklist/status on day records if user later raises tradingDaysAvailable. Contract note: comment says 'keeping completed work' but implementation does a full delete_many. Consider preserving existing day records and only appending/truncating.
Dashboard 'accountsNeeded' uses /2000 (one 50K max-payout) which is reasonable; document the assumption.
Copy trading GET picks first account as master fallback even when none flagged isMaster - acceptable but ensure UI matches expectation.
All endpoints exclude _id correctly via projection or strip().
seed_data_creation: Tests create/cleanup TEST_-prefixed accounts and journal entries; backend auto-seed of 25K Starter + 90 plan days verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_freezy_api.py for regression. testIDs follow kebab-case: add-account-btn, account-row-<uuid>, set-status-{eval|passed|funded|blown}, profit-input, consistency-input, save-metrics-btn, funded-day-num, funded-day-profit, add-funded-day-btn, payout-section-action, day-cell-<n>, day-r-input, checklist-<key>, day-notes-input, save-day-edit, add-trade-btn, trade-{market|setup|entry|risk|sl|tp|r-earned|notes}, result-{win|loss|be}, upload-screenshot, save-trade, tab-trades, tab-analytics, goto-{payouts|copy-trading|achievements|settings}-btn, open-goal-btn. Backend auto-seeds a 25K Starter on first call - tests assuming zero accounts must adapt.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. The two web console warnings are RN-web deprecation notices and do not affect functionality.
